annotations.text:
Only RECENT changes. The week strip, Start card and walkthrough banner stay real.

Sample cards carry a program position (Week 8 · Day 4), not a date: the week strip above is real and empty, and "Friday, Sep 11" would contradict it.

The Insights hook gets a link instead of numbers — it reports "this week", which is a fact about the user.

Tapping Upper B. The same CalendarWorkoutDetailView real history uses, fed from the sample store — so it looks exactly like a logged session.

Read-only: no share button, no ⋯ menu (edit, save as template, delete), no copy.

The real ChartDataService running over a throwaway in-memory store, so every metric in the dropdown and every time-range pill works. Nothing falls back to "No data for this period".

One banner, one Hide that hides every sample surface at once.

Opens with the program's two main lifts preselected, instead of "Select exercises to view progress".

Week 5 is a lighter week, so the line isn't implausibly straight.

Status card and muscle panel only — both need 8 weeks of history, which is why the sample is 8 weeks long.

No findings: a sample-backed InsightsService calling refreshIfNeeded() would overwrite the real Insights state in UserDefaults.
TODAY, for comparison — what a brand-new user sees now. All 21 people in the 1.4 funnel who finished onboarding without starting a workout saw this Home.

How sample is marked, on every surface:

• SAMPLE pill — PR-badge grammar (9pt bold, 4pt radius), in the app's existing slate "stale" token: calm, not a warning.
• Dashed slate border on every sample card and chart.
• One banner with Hide, and the same line everywhere: "Your first finished workout replaces it."

Never sample:

• Active workout and Smart Suggestions — they prescribe real weight
• Calendar and the week strip — dated facts about the user's own days
• Copy Previous — would write a real workout
• Share card and summary
• Exercise detail — its chart is embedded in the active workout
• Export, Apple Health, free-workout quota
